about: Real eventlog rows written by production (Effect v3, June 2026), one earliest row per event type, replayed in their original order. Their args are byte-for-byte what is stored on the server.

args.description: Build production and type-safe Typescript apps with Effect. In this course we go from no knowledge of effect to implementing an API request with Runtime, Layer, Config, and more.

args.summary: The effect library provides a standard library for TypeScript, enabling the building of type-safe production applications. It offers features such as error handling, configuration, mocking, and testing. A course is available to guide learners from zero knowledge to building their first API with effect.

args.contentMd: Your week was dominated by deep dives into TypeScript architecture, specifically through the lens of functional programming and state management. You explored how to build robust, type-safe backends in https://www.typeonce.dev/course/effect-beginners-complete-getting-started and investigated the complex interaction between infrastructure and code in https://github.com/livestorejs/livestore/issues/1328. Between these technical system challenges, you also found time to appreciate the visual design patterns emerging in modern UI development.
